import numpy as np
def score_recreate_action(customer_idx, target_route_idx, insert_delta, regret2_margin, route_load_after, capacity, insert_pos):
    customer_idx = np.asarray(customer_idx)
    target_route_idx = np.asarray(target_route_idx)
    insert_delta = np.asarray(insert_delta, dtype=np.float64)
    regret2_margin = np.asarray(regret2_margin, dtype=np.float64)
    route_load_after = np.asarray(route_load_after, dtype=np.float64)

    m = len(customer_idx)
    if m == 0:
        return np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float64)

    scale = np.maximum(np.mean(np.abs(insert_delta)), 1e-12)
    detour_norm = insert_delta / scale

    regret_scale = np.maximum(np.mean(np.abs(regret2_margin)), 1e-12)
    regret_norm = regret2_margin / regret_scale

    cap = max(capacity, 1e-12)
    fill = np.clip(route_load_after / cap, 0.0, 1.0)
    fill_eff = fill * (2.0 - fill)
    residual_room = 1.0 - np.clip((cap - route_load_after) / cap, 0.0, 1.0)

    insert_pos_arr = np.asarray(insert_pos, dtype=np.float64)
    pos_term = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.abs(insert_pos_arr))

    new_route_pen = np.where(target_route_idx < 0, -1.1, 0.0)

    lam = 2.0
    score = -1.1 * detour_norm + lam * regret_norm + 0.25 * fill_eff + 0.05 * residual_room + 0.02 * pos_term + new_route_pen
    return np.asarray(score, dtype=np.float64)
